_doc: Reference playbook (area of practice). The mentor's `mentor.json` describes the mentor; this file describes one playbook inside that mentor. Underscore-prefixed keys are stripped before reading. Set an optional `plugin: "<plugin-name>@<marketplace-name>"` field when the skill bodies live in a Claude-Code plugin under `<AMMP_MARKETPLACES_ROOT>/<marketplace>/plugins/<plugin>/skills/`; omit it to load `*.md` files from this directory.
name: Example mentoring
description: A starter playbook with two demo skills. Replace with your own areas of practice.
